notes.title: Wild West Supermarket Simulator is out now!
notes.content:
Howdy shopkeepers!

We hope you are as ready as we are for your journey in the Wild West! After a successful demo run during Steam Next Fest in June, we collected a lot of valuable feedback from you, the Community. We used the time to tweak, enhance and improve every level of the game, so it's ready to start into it's Early Access phase in the best way possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/408a6b20c289eec8a159a45a51d16d4435d258d0.png[/img]

[h3]Wild West Supermarket Simulator is available now![/h3]

Open your very own Wild West Store, try to balance the sheets and ideally bring in a hefty profit, and react to random events that affect the supply and demand of your customer's needs. Also, if you want a more challenging approach than the "Standard" mode, just use "realistic prices" and live from every penny you get.

While playing, you can level up your store, expand the premises and gain access to new products through various minigames. Of course, you can also decorate your shop, as well as your homestead, while overlooking the town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/5e0987b57a091fc7b41b64ffcc0d7e053ecce2c7.png[/img]

[h3]And, what's next to come?[/h3]

The next things we will focus on, are improving the game and [b]fix any bugs[/b] that may come up, as well as add [b]achievements[/b] and [b]controller support[/b].

We've also planned to add more [b]types of customers[/b], [b]new challenges for minigames[/b] and [b]extend the shelf management[/b].

And, Wild West Supermarket Simulator will get [b]more workers[/b] to hire, an [b]improved order book[/b] and [b]shelves for the storage room[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/408a6b20c289eec8a159a45a51d16d4435d258d0.png[/img]

[h3]Send us your feedback![/h3]

For Wild West Supermarket Simulator, we are very happy to receive a lot of feedback from you! And in order to sort stuff on our end in a better way, we created a Feature Upvote board, where you can simply add your feedback in a quick way - and upvote other's.

You don't have to create an account, enter your real email address (or one at all) or put in your real name. Just provide us with feedback. We will listen to your ideas and suggestions as much as possible in the future.

https://wwgss.featureupvote.com

We're looking forward to enjoying this journey with you together - and now we wish you much fun with your own store!

notes.title: A note to the community!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/6fa2ba489515164ed7d3a891ceb4284f0b8dce13.png[/img]

Dear Community,

it came to our attention that you are concerned about the project, since there haven’t been any significant updates in recent months.

We hear you!

There is no need to worry, though.

We are hard at work to put the finishing touches on the game in order to leave Early Access as soon as possible and give you the version 1.0 you have been waiting for and then continue to support the game in the foreseeable future.

However, since we decided together with the publisher Toplitz Productions, to release the game simultaneously on consoles, it complicated things a little.

All the updates that we made for the PC version also need to be included in Harvest Days for consoles.
Those versions are not handled by us but by another studio. This added another layer of possible delays – especially when problems needed to be addressed.

All sides want Harvest Days to be the best possible gaming experience you can have, regardless of if you play on PC or consoles. To achieve the quality you deserve, sometimes, like in this case, it takes a little longer than expected. But we are almost at the finish line.

We will return to the update cadence you got used to as soon as possible and appreciate your patience. We will make sure that the wait is worthwhile.

 Sincerely,

 Family Devs and Toplitz Productions

In devlog number 15 we will share the progress of Harvest Days over the past few weeks. A lot of exciting features are packed into the upcoming [b]December update EA 0.8[/b]: character customisation, pet expansion, greenhouses, achievements and many more.

[previewyoutube=W7jXR1BNQh4;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/6cb97defe3dd017dfc474d93b0709e7a29d425f0.jpg[/img]

[b]Character customisation[/b] is and was one of the most requested features and we are happy to announce that it becomes a reality in Harvest Days: My dream farm now. You will have a lot of options to choose from to make your character unique: you can choose whether you prefer to play as male or female, 12 skin colours, 45 hair styles, 12 hair colours, 6 eye types, 5 eye colours, 18 eyebrow types, 12 eyebrow colours, 15 mouth types, 18 facial hair styles, 12 facial hair colours, 9 clothing styles to choose from. If you feel undecided about the look of your character, remember that you can click the Random button and let yourself be surprised.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/7d65edb1468d42368eb947aea69a52933328cd25.png[/img]

Another new and exciting feature is the [b]pet expansion[/b]: we have added 7 new dog breeds and 7 new cat breeds. In addition, we have also added colour variations to the different dog and cat breeds. In total you have 27 pets available for adoption.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/05394b99eef944bce55a7bcada2ca29212bdd9cc.png[/img]

Let's start with the dogs: Labrador available in tan, black and chocolate colour. German Shepherd. Husky available in black, grey, and light brown. Jack Russell Terrier available in brown and black colour. Doberman available in black and brown. Corgi available in tan, brown and black. Akita Inu. Each breed of dog has its own characteristic bark.

Now we move on to the cats: Siamese cat. British shorthair available in grey and beige colour. Persian cat available in white, grey, and light brown. Sphynx. American wirehair available in orange and beige colour. Bombay cat. Maine-Coon in grey and black colour. Each cat breed has its own characteristic mew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/b30bc279b62155eac55704c97f45d73d647f78e8.jpg[/img]

To adopt any of these adorable animals you must visit [b]Rachel's animal shelter[/b], which - you will see - is brand new. We have replaced the old 3d model with a one. One reason is: Rachel now also sells pet supplies such as food and toys. Now your pets have their own needs, just like the farm animals. So, if you want your pets to be happy you will have to make sure their food and water bowls are full and play with them to increase your affinity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/5d1336c6a5b386668f80309f1225559442cbbc3e.jpg[/img]

The mechanic of [b]playing with your pets[/b] is new as well. You can throw the tennis ball to your dog, and it will bring it back to you. The same with cats, you can throw the ball of wool to your cat, and it will bring it back to you. The more affinity you have with your pets the further away from your farm they will follow you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/ce8501a519aabcf271a4c97fa7f8b35dc3e62b05.png[/img]

Another new feature is the [b]greenhouse[/b]. Greenhouses allow you to grow any crop regardless of the season you are in. Greenhouses are unlocked by levelling up the farming skill. Greenhouses are especially useful in winter as the freezing temperatures of this season prevent you from growing any crops on your land. If you have a greenhouse this will not be a problem for you, even in winter you can still harvest fruits and vegetables, the most efficient way to earn money in Harvest Days. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/6b184f416093635952426cca14fc7263ad8ce56e.jpg[/img]

And finally, the [b]achievements[/b]. We have added a total of more than 80 achievements that you can unlock as you progress. You can check the achievements in the main menu, under the achievements button.

During the last weeks, we have also fixed many bugs and improved a lot of game aspects thanks to feedback from our community. Every day we are getting closer to having the best possible game in its final version. Thanks to all of you for your support. Remember that at Family Devs we read and respond to any comments about the videos on our channel, we invite you to leave your own.

So far for today's video and see you in the next videos!

notes.title: Harvest Days: My Dream Farm - Devlog 14
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/426d1c7468132e485756dcef79fb424bac3c3459.png[/img]

Hello everyone, we are Family Devs, father and sons developing indie video games.

In devlog number 14 we will share the progress of Harvest Days over the past few weeks. A lot of exciting features are packed into the upcoming October update EA 0.7: vehicle expansion, kitchen expansion, house upgrades, barn upgrades and new crafting recipes among many other things.

Thanks to the [b]vehicle expansion[/b] you will be able to take your farm to the next level. We have included five farm vehicles, which allow you to automate tasks on your farm. The mechanic of the farm vehicles is very simple: just drive over your fields with your tractor to get the job done. With the plough you can harrow the field and remove weeds this way. The seeder sows as many seeds as you want. Just equip your seeds on your tractor by clicking on them. The sprayer waters your crops very quickly. With the manure spreader you can fertilise the sown soil with the fertiliser of your choice. Remember, there are 4 types: worm castings, organic fertiliser, basic retaining soil, and premium retaining soil. And finally, once your crops are ready for harvesting, you ought to use the largest of the farming vehicles, the combine harvester.

But the vehicle expansion doesn't just end there, in addition to the farm vehicles we have added an off roader, a quad bike and a cybercar. Of course, the pickup truck is still available as well. With these vehicles you will be the centre of attention and fun turns into exceedingly more fun.

To purchase any of these vehicles you should visit Alex's dealership.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/46a73fc1adf9b642198cae752d89301b7450acb1.jpg[/img]

We have also been working on the [b]kitchen expansion[/b]. We have added more than 40 new cooking recipes: cakes, pies, pastries, breads, typical food of some countries like United States, Germany or Spain and much more. These cooking recipes are unlocked by increasing your affinity with the villagers. Some cooking recipes are made in the kitchen, and some are made in the stone oven, which you must craft yourself. The cooked dishes can be sold, gifted, or eaten. Each villager has tastes and if you give them a dish they love, your affinity will go up a lot. Talking to villagers will sometimes give you clues about the preferences of other villagers. You can also visit villagers' homes to look for clues, for example: Rumour says Michael loves pizza? Is it true? Check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/ec92a0d23dfe17f449ce5f50690c2aaaebbc675c.jpg[/img]

Some of you may already have noticed the farmhouse beyond the house features two ‘For sale’ signs since an earlier update. Indeed, we have been working on structure upgrading for the past few weeks. There are two [b]house upgrades[/b]. To purchase one home upgrade, you must obtain enough money and resources. This grants you more space for placing your furniture and home decor. In the upcoming months we plan to deliver an update that will take home customisation to the next level. Maybe a carpenter will move into Duda's Village? Who knows, stay tuned....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/93d92c4ac39f870b4679ce69e194e6ef5423f41a.jpg[/img]

Once update EA 0.7 becomes available, you will be able to[b] automate the husbandry[/b] of your farm animals. The small barn and the barn will each have two upgrades available: an automatic feeder and an automatic drinker. To obtain either of those two upgrades you need to gather enough resources and money. Once you have these upgrades in place, you’ll never have to worry about feeding or watering the livestock again. Automating both processes is an excellent way to clear more time to spend with other activities like fishing or mining.

And lastly, soon, a new crafting machine will be available as well: a mill. The mill allows you to grind cereals and beets. You can produce your own flour or sugar, which will be especially useful for cooking recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/046b5b04f3110a258735bbf335e628db0176c46e.jpg[/img]

If you've been keeping an eye on our Steam page, you may have noticed all the recent changes to Harvest Days. The Steam cloud allows you to take your game wherever you want. Improved character movement in place due to the community feedback (Thank you all!). Alex now purchases vehicles. Kiko now sells cooked food. All adult farm animals now produce every day if they are well cared for: chickens, rabbits, cows, goats, sheep, pigs, and deer. More than 150 new cultivable plots of land on the farm. And many things more. If we’d to mention them all, this devlog would go beyond the scope.

As you can see, the development of Harvest Days is going very well. We are working hard on the game, and we will continue to work this hard with every day passing. We might also stress that we’re very happy with the feedback we receive from the community. Please keep it up! With every day we are getting closer to have the best possible game in its final version. Thanks to all of you for your support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/4fef4b04c965e58ddc053ddbd6d42f01a8e97b38.jpg[/img]

Remember that at Family Devs we read and respond to any comments about the videos on our channel, we invite you to leave your own.

So far for today's video and see you in the next videos!

notes.title: Harvest Days - Devlog #13 and Update to EA 0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/a2c7a3191bada19f8c57b6e62327063e7a8a1e82.png[/img]

Hi everyone, 

we are Family Devs, a father and sons indie game developer.

In this Devlog – bearing the ominous number 13 - we’d love to share the progress of Harvest Days over the past few weeks. 

The latest update includes the home decor expansion.

Furniture - you will now be able to craft more than 25 types of furniture such as chairs, tables, cabinets and so on. Crafting furniture remains unaltered: use the workbench, and you will unlock new crafting recipes as you progress in your crafting skill. Additionally, you can move your furniture and home decor whenever you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/ac8712696e3f8e386bfd92281d5c3fbccb0a3ff9.jpg[/img]

We have also added claw machines. You will find them in Kiko's restaurant. From the claw machines cuddly toys can be retrieved in exchange for a few coins. There is a huge variety of them, collect them all! You can use them as home decor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/9366a48ca5abc063843dcad40addde077a1ee80a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/8a1610fde994adb2af86e2b85efb06b8739c6210.jpg[/img]


In this latest update, seven new quests supplement the game, they spread throughout year 1 in-game. 
A new crafting machine is included: the preserves jar. This machine allows you to make your own pickles and jams. There is a wide variety available. And of course, while your delicious jams are being cooked you can dance!

Joining the game is a water well. The well allows you to refill your watering can anywhere on your farm. Thanks to the well you will save a lot of time to do some basic tasks like watering your crops or feeding your animals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/b695df05c41851d8d5830a4a3653accd7ecc28cb.jpg[/img]

We have updated the 3d model of the stone stove, now it has a more uniform appearance with the other assets in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/a717bba8c7dcaf4140e3b38727c5c619fb0783b9.jpg[/img]

We are also working on the Kickstarter exclusive legendary pets. More news about those soon.

As indicated above, house interiors in the villagers now have furniture and home decor. Visiting villagers' homes, you can gather clues about their preferences and get to know them better. For example, you can find out what their favourite foods are, among other things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/7308b7fcd348944ba228d74c0fc0b5554a24f508.jpg[/img]

Did we mention vehicles yet? No? You can personalize your vehicle's number plate now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/3b5aef0eb55fa63442c174385e8f6c7161b89c2c.jpg[/img]

The SOS Towing Service is already implemented. You can recover your stuck vehicle by interacting with the machines located next to the Police Station.

But above all, one of our bigger tasks in the last few weeks had been the search for a fix to the "Missing items" bug reported by some players. This has probably been the most difficult "bug" to fix in the whole development of Harvest Days. Yet, the cause is so trivial but elusive – it’s the price paid coming with standardisation. Harvest days uses .txt files for saving game data. Many countries use commas as decimal separators instead of periods. That's why the QA people from Toplitz (Germany) and we, Family Devs (Spain) didn't have any issue, but other players did (USA, UK...). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39565229/25fb4763b449a18943d6e7068d939659633db688.jpg[/img]
[i]Trying to figure the puzzle[/i]

So as suspicion hardened after all the tests we did, we did another test: We changed the language of our computer from Spanish to English and set our region to the United States. And indeed, we lost all our chests, structures, animals…

After changing the PC to our original settings (Language Spanish and region: Spain), everything reappeared. Nothing is lost. That's it!

We thank those that took to us the clues we needed. So many thanks to you!

So, even the tiniest hint, like your geo location can put us back on track. If you find bugs in the game, please report them with as many details in the description on our Discord or on Steam!

Remember that we at Family Devs read and respond to comments about the videos on our channel, we invite you to leave yours.

So far that’s it. Now today's video and see you in the next videos!

[previewyoutube=8nJkMShuPtg;full][/previewyoutube]

Family Devs

notes.title: Open-world Stardew Valley-like Harvest Days hits Steam Early Access
notes.content:
If, like many farming game fans, you've wrung every last drop of satisfaction from the likes of Stardew Valley, then you're in luck, as the open-world sim Harvest Days hits Steam Early Access today. Developed by indie 'father and sons' team Family Devs, Harvest Days: My Dream Farm puts players in charge of their own plot of land in a large, open-world area surrounding Duda's Village.

Family Devs says Harvest Days is planned to be in Early Access "for roughly six-to-nine months" and it is currently aiming for a 1.0 release in November. While the life sim game is in early access, the team plans to increase both the size of the map and the number of locations to discover; add new gameplay mechanics, vehicles, crops, animals, craftables, and NPCs; and polish up the UI, sound design, and controls and settings options.

Following in the footsteps of Stardew Valley and its predecessors including Story of Seasons, Harvest Days tasks players with all the intricacies of running their own farm - gathering, crafting, building, fishing, animal husbandry, and more. In addition, people will be able to develop and decorate their farmhouse, and invest in vehicles and heavy machinery to help them get their produce to market.

Harvest Days is a new farming sim that looks to fuse tending crops with open-world exploration. The upcoming PC game is headed to Steam Early Access this spring, and you're about to get the chance to try it for free.

Father-son duo Family Devs and publisher Toplitz Productions have revealed that they're launching a public Harvest Days demo on Steam on February 21, which arrives alongside the Steam Next Fest on the same day - a week-long event that offers hundreds of new game demos for players to try. The sim has you take over a small, neglected farm and grow it to its full potential, with "dozens of different types of fruit trees or more than 50 different crops", as a press release details.

When you're not tending your crops, you can go chill out in its low-poly open world. You can go fishing at a nearby lake, head out for some horse-riding, chew the fat with your neighbours, and explore different locations in which you'll find "dozens of secrets and surprises". There are caves full of minerals, temple ruins, and "mysterious" swamps around the valley, the devs say, so it sounds like there's some variety to be discovered.

notes.title: Open-world Stardew Valley-like Harvest Days now has a demo on Steam
notes.content:
Stardew Valley is an open-ended sandbox game with a big world to explore, but it doesn't quite scratch the same itch as a big open-world game promising limitless secrets over the horizon. Harvest Days aims to bring those gameplay styles together, and its ambition has been impressive every time we've seen it - and now, you can play it for yourself.

Harvest Days now has a free demo available on Steam, available from today until the end of the Kickstarter campaign on September 30. The game is being built by a father-son development team at Family Devs, and is scheduled to hit Early Access in the second quarter of 2022, ahead of a final release later in the year.

If you've not seen it previously, Harvest Days features everything you'd expect from a farming RPG - crops to raise, relationships with townsfolk to develop, and animals to nurture - but it also features a larger, three-dimensional world with ruins to explore, swamps to brave, and secrets to discover, as well as a variety of vehicles you can use to get around.

Read the rest of the story...
